'''Elite Ambusher''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|An elite Landbreaker ranged combatant enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB is better trained and more accurate, and is armed with better crossbow and bolts.}}

==Overview==
[[Bonekrusher Ambusher]]s enhanced by hazefyre, Elite Ambushers have similar appearance to their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of a threat; Aside from a shot from their crossbow, which deals Physical damage, they can throw a grenade, dealing Physical damage in an area.
